ai.overview: Kansas City Current bring the Belt Holders lineal championship to Racing Louisville FC on November 1st, having defended it 3 times in their current reign. The belt passes to whoever wins on the field, with no committees involved—Kansas City won it and can only lose it by losing a game.

Kansas City's dominant 5-1 victory in the most recent meeting on July 29, 2026

The all-time head-to-head favors Kansas City 6-4-2, and they've won the last 4 meetings including a dominant 5-1 result in July. Our Elo model rates Kansas City as a clear favorite, which aligns with both recent form and historical matchups.
ai.predicted_score: Kansas City Current 3, Racing Louisville FC 1
ai.prediction_writeup: Kansas City Current's 4-game winning streak and 15-9-5 record stand in stark contrast to Racing Louisville's 7-19-3 mark and recent 1-6 drubbing. The Current have dominated this matchup lately, winning the last 4 encounters and scoring 5-1 in the most recent July meeting. While Racing Louisville have held the belt 5 times before, their current form suggests they'll struggle to claim it for a 6th reign. Kansas City should retain the belt with a comfortable road victory.
